LESSON: HUMAN SEXUALITY

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Christian Living
Topic 5.2: Human Sexuality

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Human Sexuality
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can you avoid irresponsible sexual behaviour?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. describe biblical teachings on responsible sexual behaviour
2. identify values and life skills required to avoid irresponsible sexual behaviour
3. respect his or her body as the temple of the Holy Spirit

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)
